2 Joseph Travaia - 42 - fell three stories five months To-day and is unconscious ever since. His wife and son ask for your prayers ..
Pauline Garrick - 30 - baptized Cat. - rased L - Auto struck braking arm. Elboe gone since last Dec. arm in bad shape ..
Anna Otto - 43 - burning pain something like rhumtizm Maval Greer - about 26 - not Cath ..... ulsers Ruth Simpson - 24 - babtized as a child ... vocation
Page 62 July 20th Mrs. Mildred Hepler - 59 - a twin - diabetis and dropsey, headaches. Once an enthusiastic methodist sundy-school teacher .... She asks for prayers also for her twin sister who joined the Church ... but fell away and is not happy .... Tongue cured of burn
Victoria Nichblas - 50 - Possessed? went to Convent (St. Joseph's Milwaukee, Wis.) when 13 ... left after receiving "Vail" because of Mother's solicitude that she help at home. She married later on and had 8 children .... She listened to a "false prophet" who over the radio gave himself out as a priest .... and became possessed as she thinks she is .... Extremely agitated and nerveous at times.
